note: Hand-written for this repository, not taken from a dataset. 40 passages, 20 paraphrase queries; each query shares at most one content word with its gold passage (checked by tests/test_retrieval_bench.py).

passages.text: The supplier must deliver a security report every month, no later than five business days after month end.
Customer data is encrypted in transit and at rest using AES-256.
Either party may terminate this agreement with ninety days written notice.
Invoices are payable within thirty days of receipt.
The platform maintained 99.5 percent availability during the last quarter, excluding scheduled maintenance.
Access reviews for privileged accounts take place every quarter and are signed off by the security lead.
The vendor's liability is capped at the fees paid during the preceding twelve months.
Employees must complete data protection training within their first month of employment.
Revenue grew 12 percent year over year, driven mainly by the enterprise segment.
Backups are stored in a second region and restored once a year as a test.
The consultant will not disclose confidential information to any third party without prior written consent.
Customer support responds to critical incidents within one hour, around the clock.
The pilot reduced average claim processing time from nine days to four.
Subcontractors may be engaged only with the customer's approval.
Personal data is deleted ninety days after the contract ends.
The board approved a budget of 2.4 million euros for the migration.
All laptops are protected with full disk encryption and remote wipe.
The report is based on interviews with forty managers across six sites.
Late payments accrue interest at one percent per month.
The supplier warrants that the software is free of known malware at delivery.
Meeting notes are retained for two years and then archived.
The audit found that three of twelve servers ran outdated operating systems.
This agreement is governed by the laws of the Netherlands.
Staff turnover fell to eight percent after the new onboarding program.
Changes to production systems require a peer-reviewed ticket and a rollback plan.
The warranty period lasts twenty-four months from acceptance.
Forecasts assume stable energy prices through the end of next year.
Visitors must sign in at reception and wear a badge at all times.
The customer may audit the supplier's facilities once per year with reasonable notice.
Intellectual property created under this agreement belongs to the customer.
Operating costs declined because two data centers were closed.
Passwords must contain at least fourteen characters and are checked against known breach lists.
Neither party is liable for delays caused by events beyond its reasonable control.
The steering committee meets every second Tuesday to review risks.
Sample documents in this repository are synthetic and contain no client data.
Market share in the northern region increased by three points.
A disaster recovery exercise must restore critical services within four hours.
The customer is responsible for providing accurate input data.
Payment of the annual license fee is due on the first day of January.
Complaints are logged, acknowledged within two days, and resolved within thirty.

queries.text: How frequently does the vendor have to send protection summaries?
Is client information scrambled when stored or moving over the network?
Can a contracting side walk away after giving three months of advance warning?
By when must the buyer settle a bill after getting it?
What share of the time was the service up recently, apart from planned downtime?
Who signs off on the periodic checks of elevated user permissions?
What is the maximum the provider could owe if something goes wrong?
When do new hires have to finish their privacy course?
Which part of the business drove sales upward compared with the previous year?
How does the company prove it can recover from a lost copy of its records?
Is the adviser allowed to share secrets with outsiders?
How fast do helpdesk staff react to serious outages, day and night?
Did the trial make handling of insurance requests quicker?
Can outside firms be brought in to do part of the work without the client agreeing?
How long after termination does the company keep individuals' details?
How much money did directors set aside for moving to the new platform?
What happens if a staff computer is stolen?
How many people were consulted when the study was prepared?
What penalty applies when a customer pays after the due date?
Does the seller promise the program arrives without viruses?
